- The buyer will not award the contract if both final bids are priced above its value for their terms. Do not price so high that you forfeit a sure win.

2. Choose a Round 1 bid that is profitable and competitive on quality. Avoid matching the other supplier on speed unless your cost allows it cheaply.
3. Use the platform's replies only to refine the trade-off between price, delivery and quality. Do not follow them blindly.
4. In Round 3 (final bid), choose the bid that maximises (price minus your cost) multiplied by your estimated chance of winning. Keep a margin above cost, and do not raise price unless the extra delivery or quality clearly justifies it.
